assassin.description: A fast striker who exploits openings with precision and decisiveness. Excels at flanking and finishing weakened targets.
assassin.name: Assassin

guardian.description: A defensive anchor bound to protection and endurance. Guardians hold ground, absorb pressure, and reward patient Brace play.
guardian.name: Guardian

mage.description: A magical specialist with structured control over Crest resonance. Mages trade raw force for a wider, more technical toolkit.
mage.name: Mage

neutral.description: An extremely rare adaptive generalist whose Crest expression refuses to settle. Unpredictable, flexible, and politically valuable.
neutral.name: Neutral

sorcerer.description: A fast curse specialist channelling instinctive, aggressive magic. Sorcerers deny buffs and control fights through Hex.
sorcerer.name: Sorcerer

warrior.description: A frontline bruiser whose Crest expression favours direct action and guard-breaking pressure. Associated with conviction and confrontation.
warrior.name: Warrior
